doc: The showcase lane's stations. The armory (showcase_armory, ArenaArmory in res://features/showcase/arena_armory.gd) lays every finished table weapon on the hub floor in four rows east of Rivet's start (y -1.2 to 4.2, x 1.5 to 14.1, 3.15 m apart, n11: the floor guns are drawn x2; clear of rivet-motion's melee line at y -2.4, the rows at 0.6 and 2.4 straddle human-reactions' react_line at y 1.5): walk over a gun to take it into its empty carry slot, interact over one to swap it for the held gun of its class. On with --armory and by default in the showcase export (feature tag showcase) unless a --bot drives Rivet; without a --loadout Rivet starts with the pistol. Off, it lays nothing and hashes nothing.
